## What and why
Brief description of the change and the motivation. Link any related issue.

## Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / method
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist
- [ ] Runs `python -m compileall code/` clean, and the unit tests pass where relevant
- [ ] Config-driven and seeded; no result-affecting values hard-coded
- [ ] New experiments set `training.output_group` (do not overwrite existing runs)
- [ ] Does this change any reported number? If so, say which and why.
